omni.label: Engagement Code
omni.description: Harvest engagement code. The key every engagement health tile filters on.

omni.label: Company Name
omni.description: The client this engagement belongs to.

omni.label: Engagement Name
omni.description: Engagement name as it reads on the deal.

omni.label: As At
omni.description: Month end, or today for the month in progress. Every to-date figure is measured to this date.

omni.label: Is Current Month
omni.description: Yes for the month in progress.

omni.label: Is Live
omni.description: Yes where the engagement window covers today.

omni.label: Delivery Status
omni.description: Worst of budget used, burn variance, sprint budget and sprint start.

omni.label: Commercial Status
omni.description: Worst of budget rate, realised rate, earned margin and overdue invoices.

omni.label: Client Status
omni.description: Worst of contact gap and meeting sentiment. Read alongside Client Context Basis.

omni.label: Overall Status
omni.description: Worst of the three, except that client-level context is excluded because it belongs to the client rather than this engagement.

fields.name: delivery_status_caption
fields.source_sql:
CONCAT(CAST(${TABLE}.budget_used_pct AS STRING), '% of budget used against ',
                        CAST(${TABLE}.elapsed_pct AS STRING), '% elapsed. ',
                        CAST(${TABLE}.sprints_over_budget AS STRING), ' of ',
                        CAST(${TABLE}.sprints_with_budget AS STRING), ' sprints over budget.')

omni.sql:
CONCAT(CAST(${budget_used_pct} AS STRING), '% of budget used against ',
                        CAST(${elapsed_pct} AS STRING), '% elapsed. ',
                        CAST(${sprints_over_budget} AS STRING), ' of ',
                        CAST(${sprints_with_budget} AS STRING), ' sprints over budget.')
omni.label: Delivery Caption

fields.name: commercial_status_caption
fields.source_sql:
CONCAT('Realised rate £', CAST(CAST(${TABLE}.realised_hourly_rate_gbp AS INT64) AS STRING),
                        ' against budget £', CAST(CAST(${TABLE}.budget_hourly_rate_gbp AS INT64) AS STRING),
                        '. Earned margin ', CAST(${TABLE}.earned_margin_pct AS STRING), '%.')

omni.sql:
CONCAT('Realised rate £', CAST(CAST(${realised_hourly_rate_gbp} AS INT64) AS STRING),
                        ' against budget £', CAST(CAST(${budget_hourly_rate_gbp} AS INT64) AS STRING),
                        '. Earned margin ', CAST(${earned_margin_pct} AS STRING), '%.')
omni.label: Commercial Caption

fields.name: client_status_caption
fields.source_sql:
CONCAT(CAST(${TABLE}.contact_meetings_in_month AS STRING), ' meetings, last contact ',
                        IFNULL(CAST(${TABLE}.days_since_last_meeting AS STRING), 'unknown'), ' days ago. ',
                        IF(${TABLE}.client_context_basis = 'client',
                           'Client-level signal, shared with the client\'s other live engagements.',
                           'Attributed to this engagement.'))

omni.sql:
CONCAT(CAST(${contact_meetings_in_month} AS STRING), ' meetings, last contact ',
                        IFNULL(CAST(${days_since_last_meeting} AS STRING), 'unknown'), ' days ago. ',
                        IF(${client_context_basis} = 'client',
                           'Client-level signal, shared with the client\'s other live engagements.',
                           'Attributed to this engagement.'))
omni.label: Client Caption

fields.name: overall_status_sort_order
fields.source_sql: CASE ${TABLE}.overall_status WHEN 'RED' THEN 1 WHEN 'AMBER' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

omni.sql: CASE ${overall_status} WHEN 'RED' THEN 1 WHEN 'AMBER' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

omni.label: Commentary Parsed
omni.description: No means the language model returned something unparseable. Metrics and statuses are unaffected.

omni.label: Budget Hours
omni.description: Budgeted hours across every sprint on the engagement. A whole-engagement figure.

omni.label: Hours To Date
omni.description: Billable hours booked to the month end.

omni.label: Burn Variance (pts)
omni.description: Budget used percentage minus schedule elapsed percentage. Positive means budget is going faster than calendar.

omni.label: Budget Exhausted On
omni.description: The day cumulative hours first reached the budget. Blank where the budget has not been reached.

omni.label: Weekly Pace (hrs)
omni.description: Hours a week over the four weeks to the reporting date.

omni.label: Runway (weeks)
omni.description: Budget hours left divided by the weekly pace. Zero where the budget is spent.

omni.label: Projected Total Hours
omni.description: Hours to date plus the weekly pace across the days left in the window.

omni.label: Catch-up Ratio
omni.description: How much faster the team would have to work to use the remaining budget hours in the time left. 1 means the current pace lands it. Amber from 1.2, red from 2.

omni.label: Projected Delivery %
omni.description: Hours projected at the current pace as a share of budget hours.

omni.label: Sprints With A Budget
omni.description: A sprint with no budget cannot be over it, so it is left out of the over-budget share.

omni.label: Sprints Over Budget %
omni.description: Share of the engagement's budgeted sprints past 100 percent of their own budget. Amber at 50 percent, red at 75.

omni.label: Engagement Fee
omni.description: Fee across every sprint on the engagement. A whole-engagement figure.

omni.label: Delivery Cost To Date
omni.description: Labour cost plus expenses.

omni.label: Budget Hourly Rate
omni.description: Fee divided by budgeted hours. What the work was sold at.

omni.label: Realised Hourly Rate
omni.description: Recognised revenue to date divided by hours to date. What it is averaging today.

omni.label: Earned Margin %
omni.description: Revenue minus delivery cost over revenue, both to date. Earned, not projected on the full fee.

omni.label: Invoiced Not Yet Due
omni.description: Issued invoices not yet due. Harvest draft billing schedules are excluded.

omni.label: Client Context Basis
omni.description: Engagement where meetings were tied to this engagement. Client where the signal is shared with the client's other live engagements, in which case it does not set the overall status.

omni.label: Meeting Sentiment
omni.description: Average contribution sentiment in the month, from -1 to 1.

omni.label: Generic Client Meetings
omni.description: Meetings that named no engagement and were counted against every live engagement for the client.

omni.label: Reporting
omni.description: The month this row reports on.

omni.label: Red Engagements
omni.description: Engagements whose overall status is RED.
